changes.title: Smooth legs
items: Big animals' legs no longer show dark stripes across them

changes.title: Heron walk
items: Herons step their long legs when they walk
Owls, ravens, hedgehogs and moles step their feet in turn

changes.title: Audio cpu
items: No more stutter the first time a runestone powers up
Big crowds of creatures talking at once are lighter on the computer, and no longer keep cutting each other off
